proposals.expected_effect: Accumulates true P&L data for liquidity-based ranking in the Strategy Laboratory without risking live capital.
proposals.minimum_observation: 3 evaluation windows with at least 8 shadow trades and >10 eligible opportunities.
proposals.rationale: Without fresh runtime evidence, the best action is to expand the portfolio of independently measured strategy families in SHADOW mode. A liquidity-focused strategy that validates execution quality before entry will help differentiate infrastructure failures from strategy losses in future forensics.
proposals.shadow_test: Simulate trades on new liquidity pools. Deduct chain-specific gas/priority fees, slippage, and swap taxes. Falsify if net profit factor is <= 1.0 after execution costs, or if execution failures exceed 5%.
